posts.name: Bipin Raj
posts.cooked:
Hey, just wanted to ask—how will the exam be conducted? Are we going to give it on the same VM where we solve the NPPE problems? Also, what precautions should we keep in mind during the exam?

So far, I’ve only appeared for the Python OPPE exam.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
The process is similar to BPTs but the vm is different.

The exam will be conducted on the OPPE VM (terminal). The details regarding the same has been sent to your mail, kindly check and follow the mail instructions. NPPE problems are available for your practice.

Submit the public key to this website https://vm-manager-se2001-oppe-781744309994.asia-south1.run.app/passwordless

For that just do,
cd .ssh in your windows or mac terminal. For windows, use powershell.
ls
you will see a file starting with id or ed with the extension .pub copy the entire thing and submit it to the website after that you can login.

For accessing NPPE/OPPE questions just do the following
cd se2001
then create using mkdir the same directory name as the question for NPPE its (nppe_1 … nppe_5)
cd into the question dir
then solve as you did the BPTs.

Precautions -

You are allowed to switch between your exam portal and the terminal apart from that you shouldn’t access anything or even open a new tab. Rest of the instructions will be mailed to you. You can refer to that mail.
